reserves.name: ETH
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Ethereum network and Yamato CDP system

reserveReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: Yamato documents CJPY as minted against ETH pledges with a 130% minimum collateral ratio. The tracked reserve envelope is therefore the sole ETH collateral category; live position weights change onchain and are not represented as a static allocation.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve exposure outside ETH pledges is documented; current individual pledge positions are dynamic.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Native ETH collateral is an external asset rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Yamato Pool contract 0x9C1F0E3D4BD4A513721C028e1D4610CD17745f0B (collateral holding) and CjpyOS pledge registry via Yamato proxy 0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: All ETH collateral is pooled in the Yamato Pool contract with per-user pledges recorded in CjpyOS; there is no custodian, and the protocol does not lend out collateral by design. The contracts are UUPS-upgradeable by the DeFiGeek Community DAO. Legal segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness terms do not apply to contract custody; on-chain state (about 675.6 ETH pooled at 2026-07-19) is directly readable.
